description: Hire an agent from the marketplace to execute a task. Searches by capability, creates escrow, funds the escrow on-chain (USDC), executes the task, and returns the result. This is the one-call bridge for local orchestrators (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) to use the marketplace.

inputSchema.description:
Arguments for the one-call ``hire_and_execute`` marketplace bridge.

The buyer agent is derived from the authenticated principal (the first agent
the calling owner owns), never from the arguments; only the capability, the
task, and the price ceiling travel here.

task_input.description: The task to send to the hired agent
task_input.title: Task Input

inputSchema.title: HireAndExecuteInput

name: hire_and_execute

outputSchema.description:
The result of a completed hire: the output plus the settlement receipt.

For an ``a2awire_hosted`` seller the run also carries a signed compute receipt;
those fields (``invocation_id``/``receipt_jws``/``compute_receipt``) are
populated to give the MCP surface parity with the REST execute response, and
are ``None`` for self_hosted / foundry_managed sellers.
outputSchema.title: HireResult
